reviewItem.question: Is fact vf-7f11701832ba (The Helm option `endpointStatus` has been removed) still correct? Reject to retract it; correct to supersede it.

consequence.statement: Values set under endpointStatus no longer take effect; the additional endpoint statuses in the CiliumEndpoints CRD are no longer provided.
consequence.remediation: Remove endpointStatus keys and monitor endpoints via Cilium metrics (cilium_policy, cilium_policy_endpoint_enforcement_status, cilium_controllers_failing, cilium_endpoint_state) or `cilium-dbg endpoint get`.

proposed.statement: The Helm option `endpointStatus` has been removed
